datenschutzPage.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutzPage.votingIntro: To participate in polls (e.g. clip voting), you must log in with your Twitch account. Your Twitch user ID and, if applicable, your display name are stored to ensure the integrity of the poll and prevent multiple votes.
datenschutzPage.processingText: When voting, your Twitch user ID is stored together with your vote. Your IP address is not stored permanently. Authentication is via Twitch OAuth.
datenschutzPage.purposeText: Prevention of multiple votes (spam/manipulation protection) and assignment of the vote to an account.
datenschutzPage.retentionText: Votes are automatically deleted after the poll round ends (maximum 10 days). Your Twitch ID may remain stored in pseudonymized form for statistical purposes.
datenschutzPage.legalBasisText: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Legitimate interest in a manipulation-free poll).
datenschutzPage.onlyBartIntro: OnlyBart is an exclusive area for subscribers, VIPs, and moderators. Access is granted after logging in with your Twitch account. Your Twitch ID, display name, and, if applicable, profile picture are stored. Posts, comments, and likes are linked to your account.
datenschutzPage.onlyBartPurposeText: Provision of exclusive content, community interaction, and protection against abuse.
datenschutzPage.onlyBartRetentionText: Posts, comments, and likes remain stored until deleted by the user or moderation.
datenschutzPage.bartclickerIntro: When playing Bartclicker, your game progress (beard hairs, upgrades, rebirths, etc.) is stored together with your Twitch ID. Your display name is shown on the leaderboard.
datenschutzPage.bartclickerPurposeText: Storage of game progress, display of leaderboards and game statistics.
datenschutzPage.bartclickerRetentionText: Game data remains stored as long as your account exists or until you request deletion.
datenschutzPage.channelPointsIntro: The Twitch Extension displays your current channel points balance and allows you to redeem rewards. For this purpose, your Twitch user ID is transmitted via the Twitch Identity Linking API and linked to your channel points account.
datenschutzPage.channelPointsPurposeText: Display of your personal points balance, processing of reward redemptions and display of the top-10 leaderboard.
datenschutzPage.channelPointsLegalBasisText: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Legitimate interest in providing channel features).
datenschutzPage.channelPointsRetentionText: The channel points balance and reward history are stored for as long as the channel is active or until deletion is requested.
datenschutzPage.analyticsIntro: If you give your consent through the cookie banner, we collect anonymized page views to understand and improve the use of our website.
datenschutzPage.analyticsProcessingText: With each page view, the page path, timestamp and any referral information is stored. No personal data such as IP addresses is stored.
datenschutzPage.analyticsPurposeText: Analysis of page usage to improve the offering.
datenschutzPage.revokeText: You can revoke your consent at any time by deleting the cookies in your browser or by revisiting our website and declining in the cookie banner.
datenschutzPage.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. Please contact us at the address given above.
